title: 玛露希尔 · 魔物料理的真香现场
description: 迷宫营地的锅前，她从「绝对不吃魔物！」的激烈抗拒到小心翼翼地尝一口，再到捧着碗追加第二碗——三个阶段表情变化是这个角色的灵魂三连。
action: 迷宫营地的锅前，她从「绝对不吃魔物！」的激烈抗拒到小心翼翼地尝一口，再到捧着碗追加第二碗——三个阶段表情变化是这个角色的灵魂三连
camera: three-panel horizontal triptych, medium shot in each panel
promptProse: A horizontal three-panel sequence follows Marcille beside the same dungeon camp cooking pot. In the left panel, she leans away from the offered bowl with an emphatic frown and one open palm raised in refusal. In the middle panel, she cautiously tastes one spoonful, green eyes widening in surprise. In the right panel, she holds her empty bowl forward for a second helping, smiling with embarrassed enthusiasm. Each panel shows Marcille once in the same blue travel robe, cream tunic and braided blonde hair. Warm firelight and the repeated pot connect the three moments. Clear panel divisions, no speech balloons or lettering.

title: 丰川祥子 · 和解后的合奏
description: 练习室，她重新坐在键盘前与旧伙伴们合奏，阳光从窗外进来；弹奏中她闭了闭眼——「命运未必相同，内心共鸣如一」，这是她学会的、最珍贵的一件事。
action: 练习室，她重新坐在键盘前与旧伙伴们合奏，阳光从窗外进来
camera: wide ensemble shot, keyboard foreground and bandmates visible behind
promptProse: Sakiko plays the rehearsal keyboard in the foreground, closing her amber eyes briefly as her former bandmates join the phrase. A vocalist stands beside a microphone, a guitarist and bassist face inward with their instruments, and a drummer keeps time at the rear. The five musicians have distinct hairstyles and separate positions; they share the same rehearsal room and visibly play together. Sakiko wears a cream knit top and blue trousers, with ribbons holding her blue hair. Afternoon window light crosses the keyboard and occupied music stands. An imagined reconciliation rendered as a warm ensemble scene, no lettering.

title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 圣杯战争
description: 【伊莉雅 · 圣杯战争】烈火燃烧的废墟战场上，娇小的伊莉雅傲然端坐在庞大如巨山的狂战士（Berserker）肩头，狂风肆虐吹乱她的银白长发。她俯视着战场发出银铃般清脆的笑声——「Berserker，把阻挡在大哥哥面前的敌对从者全部碾碎！这就是爱因兹贝伦的力量！」
location: 冬木市燃烧的街道废墟
camera: wide low-angle two-character shot, full Berserker figure and Illya seated on his shoulder
promptProse: Illyasviel sits securely on Berserker’s broad muscular shoulder above a ruined street in Fuyuki. Her red fur-trimmed winter coat and long white hair lift in the wind as she extends one commanding hand toward the distant battlefield, ruby eyes bright with confidence. Berserker stands planted among broken paving stones beneath her, his battle skirt and greaves visible and his weapon held low. Firelight edges the two distinct figures while cool moonlight separates Illya’s silhouette from the smoke. One girl riding on one towering warrior’s shoulder, both fully within the vertical frame, no injuries or lettering.
